description: Points d'accès Wifi is a dataset listed in Open Data Hauts-de-Seine, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Rueil-Malmaison. Localisation des accès gratuits au Wifi sur le territoire. Face à la nécessité de transformer les villes pour les adapter aux nouveaux modes de communication et afin de faciliter l'accès au service public, Rueil-Malmaison s'engage dans un vaste programme de transformation pour devenir une véritable ville numérique. Coverage: Hauts-de-Seine. The portal files it under Equipement / Services. Its keywords are wifi, point d'accès, public. The portal shows 19 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-11-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-hauts-de-seine-fr-portal.
